purpose: One body row of a Table: a strip of cells with a hairline under it and its own states for hover, selection, focus, disabled and drag.

notFor.case: The header row with the column names.
Not for standalone use outside a Table.
A card people drag between lanes on a board.

Default.visual: No fill; a bottom hairline in Border/subtle (Stroke/divider).

Hover.meaning: The pointer is over an interactive row; only selectable or actionable rows hover.

Focused.meaning: An interactive row reached by keyboard (focus-visible).
Focused.visual: No fill; a Border/focus stroke at Stroke/focus all round in place of the bottom hairline.

Disabled.meaning: Cannot be used: sets aria-disabled and skips its action.
Disabled.visual: Same as Default; the cells carry their own Disabled ink.

Dragging.visual: Fill Surface/layer-2 with a Border/default stroke (Stroke/divider) all round.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable unless it is interactive (interactive / onClick); then Tab reaches it. The contract does not say which keys act on it.
a11y.reducedMotion: Fill and ink changes run on use-hover, which keeps its duration under reduced motion: a colour change, not travel (lib/motion.ts KEEP_UNDER_REDUCED).
notes: While a row is dragged, announce the move through a live region; TableDropIndicator is decorative.

openQuestions: Keyboard: Table's behaviour says rows never take focus, yet TableRow has a Focused state for interactive rows. Which keys act on a focused row (Enter to open, Space to select)?
Reordering: is there a keyboard way to move a row, or is Dragging pointer-only?
